sentences.text: 1. This Criminal Petition, under Section 438 of the CrPC is filed seeking to enlarge the petitioners/A2 and A4 on anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.131 of 2024 of Ananthapuramu III Town Police Station of Ananthapuramu District for the offences punishable under sections 498A and 306 read with 34 IPC.

entities.text: Ananthapuramu III Town Police Station of Ananthapuramu District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard arguments of Sri Narasimhulu Parise, the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent/ State.
3.

On hearing the learned counsel on both sides and on perusal of the record, the following aspects are to be noticed:
Deceased is a married lady.
A1 is her husband.
The present petitioners are A2 and A4.
A2 is stated to be the mother and A4 is stated to be the sister of A1.
The allegations are that A1 used to suspect the chastity of his wife and used to harass her.
On 30.06.2024, the married lady allegedly committed suicide in her own house.
Her father is the de facto complainant.
In his written information, he stated that A1 used to beat the victim lady and unable to bear the harassment, she committed suicide.
The only allegation against these petitioners is that even they used to support A1.
The facts on record do not indicate these petitioners living along with A1.
In the bail petition, it is urged that these petitioners are living at a different place and they were not living with A1 and the deceased lady.
Facts also do not show petitioners aiding or abetting suicide of the married lady.
4. It is in these circumstances, this court finds that any custodial interrogation does not seem necessary.
Hence, prayer is granted.
5. In the result, this criminal petition is allowed in the following terms:

In the event of arrest, the petitioners/A2 and A4 shall be enlarged on bail on executing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only)
each with two sureties of the like sum each to the satisfaction of the investigating officer concerned.
The petitioners shall mark their attendance before the Investigating Officer on 1st and 15th of every month between 10.00 AM and 1.00 PM till filing of the charge sheet.

The petitioners shall make themselves available for investigation by a police officer as and when required, and they shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any persons acquainted with the facts of the case to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any Mangali Lakshmidevi, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154328203/
1 police officer.
